sanskrit: gateṣv atha nṛpo bhūyaḥ paureṣu saha mantribhiḥ mantrayitvā tataś cakre niścayajñaḥ sa niścayam
english: Then, after the citizens had departed, the king once more deliberated together with his ministers; and he who was wise in firm resolve made a firm resolve.

sanskrit: śva eva puṣyo bhavitā śvo 'bhiṣecyeta me sutaḥ rāmo rājīvatāmrākṣo yauvarājya iti prabhuḥ
english: "Tomorrow is the Puṣya asterism; tomorrow let my son Rāma — his eyes red as lotus — be consecrated to the office of crown prince." So declared the lord.

sanskrit: athāntargṛham āviśya rājā daśarathas tadā sūtam ājñāpayām āsa rāmaṃ punar ihānaya
english: Then king Daśaratha entered his private apartments and commanded his charioteer: "Bring Rāma back here again."

sanskrit: pratigṛhya sa tadvākyaṃ sūtaḥ punar upāyayau rāmasya bhavanaṃ śīghraṃ rāmam ānayituṃ punaḥ
english: Receiving that command, the charioteer once more went swiftly to Rāma's dwelling to bring Rāma back again.

sanskrit: dvāḥsthair āveditaṃ tasya rāmāyāgamanaṃ punaḥ śrutvaiva cāpi rāmas taṃ prāptaṃ śaṅkānvito 'bhavat
english: The doorkeepers announced to Rāma the charioteer's renewed arrival; and even as Rāma heard of his coming, he was filled with apprehension.

sanskrit: praveśya cainaṃ tvaritaṃ rāmo vacanam abravīt yad āgamanakṛtyaṃ te bhūyas tad brūhy aśeṣataḥ
english: Having quickly admitted him, Rāma spoke these words: "Tell me fully and completely the purpose that brings you here again."

sanskrit: tam uvāca tataḥ sūto rājā tvāṃ draṣṭum icchati śrutvā pramāṇam atra tvaṃ gamanāyetarāya vā
english: Then the charioteer said to him: "The king desires to see you; having heard his word, you may decide whether to go or not."

sanskrit: iti sūtavacaḥ śrutvā rāmo 'tha tvarayānvitaḥ prayayau rājabhavanaṃ punar draṣṭuṃ nareśvaram
english: Hearing the charioteer's words, Rāma then set out in haste to the royal palace to see the lord of men once more.

sanskrit: taṃ śrutvā samanuprāptaṃ rāmaṃ daśaratho nṛpaḥ praveśayām āsa gṛhaṃ vivikṣuḥ priyam uttamam
english: King Daśaratha, upon hearing that Rāma had arrived, caused his beloved and most excellent son to be ushered into the inner chamber.

sanskrit: praviśann eva ca śrīmān rāghavo bhavanaṃ pituḥ dadarśa pitaraṃ dūrāt praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ
english: The glorious Rāghava, even as he entered his father's dwelling, saw his father from afar, bowed down before him with hands cupped in reverence.

sanskrit: praṇamantaṃ samutthāpya taṃ pariṣvajya bhūmipaḥ pradiśya cāsmai ruciram āsanaṃ punar abravīt
english: The lord of the earth raised him as he bowed, embraced him, directed a splendid seat to be given him, and then spoke again.

sanskrit: rāma vṛddho 'smi dīrghāyur bhuktā bhogā mayepsitāḥ annavadbhiḥ kratuśatais tatheṣṭaṃ bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ
english: "Rāma, I am old and have lived a long life; I have enjoyed all the pleasures I desired; I have performed hundreds of sacrifices with lavish food and generous dakṣiṇā-offerings.

sanskrit: jātam iṣṭam apatyaṃ me tvam adyānupamaṃ bhuvi dattam iṣṭam adhītaṃ ca mayā puruṣasattama
english: You, O best of men, have been born to me as the beloved and peerless offspring on this earth; I have made the desired gifts and have pursued the desired learning.

sanskrit: anubhūtāni ceṣṭāni mayā vīra sukhāni ca devarṣi pitṛviprāṇām anṛṇo 'smi tathātmanaḥ
english: O hero, I have also experienced the desired pleasures; I am free from debt to the gods, to the sages, to the ancestors, to the Brāhmaṇas, and to my own self.

sanskrit: na kiṃ cin mama kartavyaṃ tavānyatrābhiṣecanāt ato yat tvām ahaṃ brūyāṃ tan me tvaṃ kartum arhasi
english: There is nothing left for me to accomplish other than your consecration; therefore whatever I tell you, you ought to carry it out for my sake.

sanskrit: adya prakṛtayaḥ sarvās tvām icchanti narādhipam atas tvāṃ yuvarājānam abhiṣekṣyāmi putraka
english: Today all the ministers of state desire you as their sovereign; therefore, my son, I shall consecrate you as crown prince."

sanskrit: api cādyāśubhān rāma svapnān paśyāmi dāruṇān sanirghātā maholkāś ca patantīha mahāsvanāḥ
english: "Moreover, Rāma, today I see inauspicious and terrible dreams: great meteors accompanied by thunderbolts fall here with a mighty roar.

sanskrit: avaṣṭabdhaṃ ca me rāma nakṣatraṃ dāruṇair grahaiḥ āvedayanti daivajñāḥ sūryāṅgārakarāhubhiḥ
english: And the astrologers report to me, Rāma, that my birth star is beset by terrible planets — the Sun, Mars, and Rāhu.

sanskrit: prāyeṇa hi nimittānām īdṛśānāṃ samudbhave rājā vā mṛtyum āpnoti ghorāṃ vāpadam ṛcchati
english: For when such omens as these appear, a king generally meets with death or encounters a dreadful calamity.

sanskrit: tad yāvad eva me ceto na vimuhyati rāghava tāvad evābhiṣiñcasva calā hi prāṇināṃ matiḥ
english: Therefore, Rāghava, while my mind is still unconfused, let the consecration be performed without delay, for the minds of living beings are ever unstable.

sanskrit: adya candro 'bhyupagataḥ puṣyāt pūrvaṃ punar vasum śvaḥ puṣya yogaṃ niyataṃ vakṣyante daivacintakāḥ
english: Today the moon has come to Punarvasu, one asterism before Puṣya; tomorrow the astrologers will certainly announce the conjunction with Puṣya.

sanskrit: tatra puṣye 'bhiṣiñcasva manas tvarayatīva mām śvas tvāham abhiṣekṣyāmi yauvarājye paraṃtapa
english: Under that Puṣya asterism let the consecration take place — my mind urges me toward haste. O scorcher of foes, tomorrow I shall consecrate you to the office of crown prince.

sanskrit: tasmāt tvayādya vratinā niśeyaṃ niyatātmanā saha vadhvopavastavyā darbhaprastaraśāyinā
english: Therefore tonight you must observe a religious vow, with your mind disciplined and controlled, lying upon a bed of darbha-grass together with your wife, fasting the night.

sanskrit: suhṛdaś cāpramattās tvāṃ rakṣantv adya samantataḥ bhavanti bahuvighnāni kāryāṇy evaṃvidhāni hi
english: And let your trusted friends guard you on all sides without negligence today, for undertakings of this kind are attended by many obstacles.

sanskrit: viproṣitaś ca bharato yāvad eva purād itaḥ tāvad evābhiṣekas te prāptakālo mato mama
english: And since Bharata is absent from the city, this is precisely the opportune moment for your consecration — such is my considered view.

sanskrit: kāmaṃ khalu satāṃ vṛtte bhrātā te bharataḥ sthitaḥ jyeṣṭhānuvartī dharmātmā sānukrośo jitendriyaḥ
english: To be sure, your brother Bharata stands firm in the conduct of the virtuous — he is obedient to his elder, righteous in spirit, compassionate, and master of his senses.

sanskrit: kiṃ tu cittaṃ manuṣyāṇām anityam iti me matiḥ satāṃ ca dharmanityānāṃ kṛtaśobhi ca rāghava
english: Yet the human mind is fickle — such is my conviction; and even of the virtuous who are ever steadfast in righteousness, the character can be enhanced by what is already accomplished, O Rāghava.

sanskrit: ity uktaḥ so 'bhyanujñātaḥ śvobhāviny abhiṣecane vrajeti rāmaḥ pitaram abhivādyābhyayād gṛham
english: Thus addressed and granted leave regarding the consecration to take place on the morrow with the word "Go," Rāma paid obeisance to his father and proceeded to his own dwelling.

sanskrit: praviśya cātmano veśma rājñoddiṣṭe 'bhiṣecane tasmin kṣaṇe vinirgatya mātur antaḥpuraṃ yayau
english: Having entered his own dwelling, and learning of the consecration appointed by the king, he departed that very instant and went to his mother's inner apartments.

sanskrit: tatra tāṃ pravaṇām eva mātaraṃ kṣaumavāsinīm vāgyatāṃ devatāgāre dadarśa yācatīṃ śriyam
english: There he found his mother, clad in silk garments, engrossed in silent prayer in the household shrine, beseeching the goddess of prosperity.

sanskrit: prāg eva cāgatā tatra sumitrā lakṣmaṇas tathā sītā cānāyitā śrutvā priyaṃ rāmābhiṣecanam
english: Sumitrā had already arrived there, as had Lakṣmaṇa; and Sītā too had been summoned upon hearing the glad news of Rāma's consecration.

sanskrit: tasmin kāle hi kausalyā tasthāv āmīlitekṣaṇā sumitrayānvāsyamānā sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca
english: At that time Kausalyā stood with half-closed eyes in meditation, attended by Sumitrā, by Sītā, and by Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: śrutvā puṣyeṇa putrasya yauvarājyābhiṣecanam prāṇāyāmena puruṣaṃ dhyāyamānā janārdanam
english: Having heard of her son's consecration as crown prince under the Puṣya asterism, she was engaged in breath-control exercises while meditating upon the divine Janārdana.

sanskrit: tathā saniyamām eva so 'bhigamyābhivādya ca uvāca vacanaṃ rāmo harṣayaṃs tām idaṃ tadā
english: Approaching his mother who was thus absorbed in her religious observances and paying reverence to her, Rāma then spoke these words, gladdening her heart.

sanskrit: amba pitrā niyukto 'smi prajāpālanakarmaṇi bhavitā śvo 'bhiṣeko me yathā me śāsanaṃ pituḥ
english: "Mother, I have been appointed by my father to the task of protecting the subjects; my consecration will take place tomorrow — such is my father's command to me.

sanskrit: sītayāpy upavastavyā rajanīyaṃ mayā saha evam ṛtvigupādhyāyaiḥ saha mām uktavān pitā
english: Tonight Sītā and I must keep a fast together — so has my father commanded me, in the presence of the officiating priests and the preceptors."

sanskrit: yāni yāny atra yogyāni śvobhāviny abhiṣecane tāni me maṅgalāny adya vaidehyāś caiva kāraya
english: "Whatever auspicious rites are appropriate here for the consecration tomorrow — arrange them today for me and for the Vaidehī as well."

sanskrit: etac chrutvā tu kausalyā cirakālābhikāṅkṣitam harṣabāṣpakalaṃ vākyam idaṃ rāmam abhāṣata
english: Hearing this long-cherished news, Kausalyā spoke these words to Rāma, her voice broken with tears of joy.

sanskrit: vatsa rāma ciraṃ jīva hatās te paripanthinaḥ jñātīn me tvaṃ śriyā yuktaḥ sumitrāyāś ca nandaya
english: "My son Rāma, live long; may your enemies be slain. Endowed with royal splendour, bring joy to me and to Sumitrā and to all our kinsmen.

sanskrit: kalyāṇe bata nakṣatre mayi jāto 'si putraka yena tvayā daśaratho guṇair ārādhitaḥ pitā
english: "Truly you were born to me under an auspicious star, my son — for by your virtues you have won the deepest affection of your father Daśaratha.

sanskrit: amoghaṃ bata me kṣāntaṃ puruṣe puṣkarekṣaṇe yeyam ikṣvākurājyaśrīḥ putra tvāṃ saṃśrayiṣyati
english: "Surely my patient endurance in bearing you, O man with eyes like lotus-petals, has not been in vain — for the royal splendour of the Ikṣvāku line shall now, my son, find its refuge in you."

sanskrit: ity evam ukto mātredaṃ rāmo bhāratam abravīt prāñjaliṃ prahvam āsīnam abhivīkṣya smayann iva
english: Thus addressed by his mother, Rāma spoke these worthy words, glancing with a smile at Lakṣmaṇa who sat with folded hands and bowed head.

sanskrit: lakṣmaṇemāṃ mayā sārdhaṃ praśādhi tvaṃ vasuṃdharām dvitīyaṃ me 'ntarātmānaṃ tvām iyaṃ śrīr upasthitā
english: "Lakṣmaṇa, rule this earth together with me — you who are as my second self, my inner soul; this royal fortune has come to you as much as to me."

sanskrit: saumitre bhuṅkṣva bhogāṃs tvam iṣṭān rājyaphalāni ca jīvitaṃ ca hi rājyaṃ ca tvadartham abhikāmaye
english: "Son of Sumitrā, enjoy the pleasures you desire and all the fruits of kingship; for it is for your sake that I long for both my life and the kingdom."

sanskrit: ity uktvā lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo mātarāv abhivādya ca abhyanujñāpya sītāṃ ca jagāma svaṃ niveśanam
english: Having thus spoken to Lakṣmaṇa, Rāma paid obeisance to both mothers, obtained the permission of Sītā, and departed to his own dwelling.

sanskrit: saṃdiśya rāmaṃ nṛpatiḥ śvobhāviny abhiṣecane purohitaṃ samāhūya vasiṣṭham idam abravīt
english: Having given instructions to Rāma regarding the consecration on the morrow, the king summoned his family priest Vasiṣṭha and spoke these words.

sanskrit: gacchopavāsaṃ kākutsthaṃ kārayādya tapodhana śrīyaśorājyalābhāya vadhvā saha yatavratam
english: "Go, O wealth of austerity, and cause the descendant of Kākutstha today to observe a fast, keeping his vow diligently together with his wife, for the attainment of royal glory, fame, and sovereignty."

sanskrit: tatheti ca sa rājānam uktvā vedavidāṃ varaḥ svayaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavān yayau rāmaniveśanam
english: Replying "So be it" to the king, the venerable Vasiṣṭha — best among those learned in the Veda — himself went to Rāma's dwelling.

sanskrit: sa rāmabhavanaṃ prāpya pāṇḍurābhraghanaprabham tisraḥ kakṣyā rathenaiva viveśa munisattamaḥ
english: That best of sages, reaching Rāma's dwelling which shone like a dense white cloud, entered three successive courtyards in his chariot itself.

sanskrit: tam āgatam ṛṣiṃ rāmas tvarann iva sasaṃbhramaḥ mānayiṣyan sa mānārhaṃ niścakrāma niveśanāt
english: Rāma, eager to honour him who was worthy of honour, went out of his dwelling to receive the arriving sage, hastening with a manner of respectful agitation.

sanskrit: abhyetya tvaramāṇaś ca rathābhyāśaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ tato 'vatārayām āsa parigṛhya rathāt svayam
english: Approaching quickly to the proximity of the sage's chariot, he then helped the wise one down from the chariot, taking hold of him himself.

sanskrit: sa cainaṃ praśritaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃbhāṣyābhiprasādya ca priyārhaṃ harṣayan rāmam ity uvāca purohitaḥ
english: Seeing him humble and reverent, the family priest addressed him with pleased and gracious words, gladdening Rāma who was so deserving of joy, and spoke thus.

sanskrit: prasannas te pitā rāma yauvarājyam avāpsyasi upavāsaṃ bhavān adya karotu saha sītayā
english: "Rāma, your father is pleased; you shall attain the office of crown prince. Let Your Honour today observe a fast together with Sītā."

sanskrit: prātas tvām abhiṣektā hi yauvarājye narādhipaḥ pitā daśarathaḥ prītyā yayātiṃ nahuṣo yathā
english: "For in the morning your father, King Daśaratha, will consecrate you to the office of crown prince with loving delight, even as Nahuṣa once consecrated Yayāti."

sanskrit: ity uktvā sa tadā rāmam upavāsaṃ yatavratam mantravat kārayām āsa vaidehyā sahitaṃ muniḥ
english: Having spoken thus, the sage then caused Rāma, diligently keeping his vow, to observe the fast together with the Vaidehī, in accordance with the prescribed Vedic rites.

sanskrit: tato yathāvad rāmeṇa sa rājño gurur arcitaḥ abhyanujñāpya kākutsthaṃ yayau rāmaniveśanāt
english: Then, having been duly worshipped by Rāma according to proper custom, the royal preceptor took his leave of the descendant of Kākutstha and departed from Rāma's dwelling.

sanskrit: suhṛdbhis tatra rāmo 'pi tān anujñāpya sarvaśaḥ sabhājito viveśātha tān anujñāpya sarvaśaḥ
english: Rāma too, having been honoured there by his well-wishers, took leave of them all and entered his dwelling, dismissing them all with his blessing.

sanskrit: hṛṣṭanārī narayutaṃ rāmaveśma tadā babhau yathā mattadvijagaṇaṃ praphullanalinaṃ saraḥ
english: Rāma's dwelling, thronged with rejoicing women and men, shone at that time like a lake filled with fully bloomed lotuses and joyful flocks of birds.

sanskrit: sa rājabhavanaprakhyāt tasmād rāmaniveśanāt nirgatya dadṛśe mārgaṃ vasiṣṭho janasaṃvṛtam
english: Vasiṣṭha, departing from that Rāma's dwelling which rivalled the royal palace, beheld the roads filled with crowds of people.

sanskrit: vṛndavṛndair ayodhyāyāṃ rājamārgāḥ samantataḥ babhūvur abhisaṃbādhāḥ kutūhalajanair vṛtāḥ
english: In Ayodhyā the royal highways in every direction were completely crowded and thronged with people eager with curiosity, gathered in groups upon groups.

sanskrit: janavṛndormisaṃgharṣaharṣasvanavatas tadā babhūva rājamārgasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ
english: At that time the noise of the royal highway, resounding with the joyful sounds of human waves and surging crowds, was like the roar of the ocean.

sanskrit: siktasaṃmṛṣṭarathyā hi tad ahar vanamālinī āsīd ayodhyā nagarī samucchritagṛhadhvajā
english: That day the city of Ayodhyā, adorned with garlands of forest-flowers and with banners raised above its houses, had its streets sprinkled and swept clean.

sanskrit: tadā hy ayodhyā nilayaḥ sastrībālābalo janaḥ rāmābhiṣekam ākāṅkṣann ākāṅkṣann udayaṃ raveḥ
english: For then all the inhabitants of Ayodhyā — women, children, the aged, and the strong alike — yearning for Rāma's consecration, longed for the rising of the sun.

sanskrit: prajālaṃkārabhūtaṃ ca janasyānandavardhanam utsuko 'bhūj jano draṣṭuṃ tam ayodhyā mahotsavam
english: The people became eager to behold that great festival of Ayodhyā which was the very ornament of the subjects and the increaser of the people's joy.

sanskrit: evaṃ taṃ janasaṃbādhaṃ rājamārgaṃ purohitaḥ vyūhann iva janaughaṃ taṃ śanai rāja kulaṃ yayau
english: Thus the family priest, as if cleaving through that mass of people, made his way slowly through the crowd-thronged royal highway toward the royal palace.

sanskrit: sitābhraśikharaprakhyaṃ prāsadam adhiruhya saḥ samiyāya narendreṇa śakreṇeva bṛhaspatiḥ
english: Ascending the palace whose pinnacles resembled white clouds, he came before the king of men, even as Bṛhaspati comes before Śakra, lord of the gods.

sanskrit: tam āgatam abhiprekṣya hitvā rājāsanaṃ nṛpaḥ papraccha sa ca tasmai tat kṛtam ity abhyavedayat
english: Beholding him as he arrived, the king rose from his royal seat and inquired; and Vasiṣṭha duly reported to him that the matter had been accomplished.

sanskrit: guruṇā tv abhyanujñāto manujaughaṃ visṛjya tam viveśāntaḥpuraṃ rājā siṃho giriguhām iva
english: Dismissed by his preceptor, the king, having dispersed those throngs of men, entered his inner apartments like a lion entering a mountain cave.

sanskrit: tad agryaveṣapramadājanākulaṃ mahendraveśmapratimaṃ niveśanam vyadīpayaṃś cāru viveśa pārthivaḥ śaśīva tārāgaṇasaṃkulaṃ nabhaḥ
english: That dwelling, thronged with women adorned in finest attire and rivalling the palace of the great Indra, the king made to radiate with his glorious entry, even as the moon illumines the sky crowded with multitudes of stars.

sanskrit: gate purohite rāmaḥ snāto niyatamānasaḥ saha patnyā viśālākṣyā nārāyaṇam upāgamat
english: After the departure of the family priest, Rāma, having bathed and with mind controlled and composed, approached Nārāyaṇa together with his wide-eyed wife.

sanskrit: pragṛhya śirasā pātrīṃ haviṣo vidhivat tadā mahate daivatāyājyaṃ juhāva jvalite 'nale
english: Taking on his head the vessel of the oblation offering, he then, in accordance with the prescribed rites, poured the clarified butter as a libation into the blazing fire for the great divinity.

sanskrit: śeṣaṃ ca haviṣas tasya prāśyāśāsyātmanaḥ priyam dhyāyan nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svāstīrṇe kuśasaṃstare
english: And having consumed the remainder of the oblation, invoking blessings upon himself, meditating upon the divine Nārāyaṇa, he lay upon a well-spread bed of kuśa-grass.

sanskrit: vāgyataḥ saha vaidehyā bhūtvā niyatamānasaḥ śrīmaty āyatane viṣṇoḥ śiśye naravarātmajaḥ
english: Maintaining silence, with controlled mind, the son of the best of men lay in the beautiful shrine of Viṣṇu, together with the Vaidehī.

sanskrit: ekayāmāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ rātryāṃ prativibudhya saḥ alaṃkāravidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ kārayām āsa veśmanaḥ
english: When but one watch of the night remained, he awoke and caused the entire prescribed arrangement of decorations to be prepared throughout the dwelling.

sanskrit: tatra śṛṇvan sukhā vācaḥ sūtamāgadhabandinām pūrvāṃ saṃdhyām upāsīno jajāpa yatamānasaḥ
english: There, listening to the pleasant words of the panegyrists — bards, heralds, and eulogists — he attended to the rites of the early morning twilight and performed his silent prayers with concentrated mind.

sanskrit: tuṣṭāva praṇataś caiva śirasā madhusūdanam vimalakṣaumasaṃvīto vācayām āsa ca dvijān
english: He also hymned and bowed with his head before the slayer of Madhu, clad in spotless silken garments, and caused the Brāhmaṇas to recite sacred texts.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ puṇyāhaghoṣo 'tha gambhīramadhuras tadā ayodhyāṃ pūrayām āsa tūryaghoṣānunāditaḥ
english: Then their holy-day proclamations — deep, melodious, and resonant — filled all of Ayodhyā, re-echoing with the sound of musical instruments.

sanskrit: kṛtopavāsaṃ tu tadā vaidehyā saha rāghavam ayodhyā nilayaḥ śrutvā sarvaḥ pramudito janaḥ
english: All the inhabitants of Ayodhyā, upon hearing that the Rāghava had kept his fast together with the Vaidehī, were exceedingly joyful.

sanskrit: tataḥ paurajanaḥ sarvaḥ śrutvā rāmābhiṣecanam prabhātāṃ rajanīṃ dṛṣṭvā cakre śobhāṃ parāṃ punaḥ
english: Then all the citizens of the city, having heard of Rāma's consecration and seeing the night give way to dawn, made the city resplendent once more with supreme adornment.

sanskrit: sitābhraśikharābheṣu devatāyataneṣu ca catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu caityeṣv aṭṭālakeṣu ca
english: In the temples of the gods whose pinnacles were like white clouds, at the crossroads, on the thoroughfares, at the sacred shrines, and on the turrets and towers —

sanskrit: nānāpaṇyasamṛddheṣu vaṇijām āpaṇeṣu ca kuṭumbināṃ samṛddheṣu śrīmatsu bhavaneṣu ca
english: — in the merchants' stalls stocked with various wares, and in the prosperous and beautiful houses of householders —

sanskrit: sabhāsu caiva sarvāsu vṛkṣeṣv ālakṣiteṣu ca dhvajāḥ samucchritāś citrāś patākāś cābhavaṃs tadā
english: — in all the assembly halls and even on the visible trees, decorated banners were raised and colourful flags were displayed at that time.

sanskrit: naṭanartakasaṃghānāṃ gāyakānāṃ ca gāyatām manaḥkarṇasukhā vācaḥ śuśruvuś ca tatas tataḥ
english: And from here and there were heard the words — pleasing to both the mind and the ear — of troupes of actors and dancers and of singers as they sang.

sanskrit: rāmābhiṣekayuktāś ca kathāś cakrur mitho janāḥ rāmābhiṣeke saṃprāpte catvareṣu gṛheṣu ca
english: People conversed among themselves about matters relating to Rāma's consecration; at the crossroads and in their homes, with Rāma's consecration having arrived, they talked of nothing else.

sanskrit: bālā api krīḍamānā gṛhadvāreṣu saṃghaśaḥ rāmābhiṣekasaṃyuktāś cakrur eva mithaḥ kathāḥ
english: Even children at play, gathered in groups at the doorways of houses, spoke among themselves of nothing else but what pertained to Rāma's consecration.

sanskrit: kṛtapuṣpopahāraś ca dhūpagandhādhivāsitaḥ rājamārgaḥ kṛtaḥ śrīmān paurai rāmābhiṣecane
english: The royal highway was made magnificent by the citizens on the occasion of Rāma's consecration, adorned with flower offerings and pervaded with the fragrance of incense.

sanskrit: prakāśīkaraṇārthaṃ ca niśāgamanaśaṅkayā dīpavṛkṣāṃs tathā cakrur anu rathyāsu sarvaśaḥ
english: And fearing the coming of night — wishing to keep it illuminated — they also erected lamp-trees all along the streets in every direction.

sanskrit: alaṃkāraṃ purasyaivaṃ kṛtvā tat puravāsinaḥ ākāṅkṣamāṇā rāmasya yauvarājyābhiṣecanam
english: Having thus adorned the city in this manner, all the inhabitants of the city, longing for the consecration of Rāma to the office of crown prince —

sanskrit: sametya saṃghaśaḥ sarve catvareṣu sabhāsu ca kathayanto mithas tatra praśaśaṃsur janādhipam
english: — assembled together in groups at the crossroads and in the assembly halls, speaking to one another and praising the lord of men.

sanskrit: aho mahātmā rājāyam ikṣvākukulanandanaḥ jñātvā yo vṛddham ātmānaṃ rāmaṃ rājye 'bhiṣekṣyati
english: "Ah, how magnanimous is this king, this joy of the Ikṣvāku line — who, recognizing himself as old, will consecrate Rāma to the kingship!"

sanskrit: sarve hy anugṛhītāḥ sma yan no rāmo mahīpatiḥ cirāya bhavitā goptā dṛṣṭalokaparāvaraḥ
english: "We are all truly blessed, in that Rāma — a seer of all worlds, high and low — will be our protector and lord of the earth for a long time to come."

sanskrit: anuddhatamanā vidvān dharmātmā bhrātṛvatsalaḥ yathā ca bhrātṛṣu snigdhas tathāsmāsv api rāghavaḥ
english: "A man of humble mind, learned, righteous in spirit, devoted to his brothers — as the Rāghava is affectionate to his brothers, so is he to us as well."

sanskrit: ciraṃ jīvatu dharmātmā rājā daśaratho 'naghaḥ yatprasādenābhiṣiktaṃ rāmaṃ drakṣyāmahe vayam
english: "Long may the blameless and righteous king Daśaratha live — by whose grace we shall behold the consecrated Rāma!"

sanskrit: evaṃvidhaṃ kathayatāṃ paurāṇāṃ śuśruvus tadā digbhyo 'pi śrutavṛttāntāḥ prāptā jānapadā janāḥ
english: While the city-dwellers were conversing in this manner, people from the rural districts arrived — those who had already heard the news — coming from all the quarters.

sanskrit: te tu digbhyaḥ purīṃ prāptā draṣṭuṃ rāmābhiṣecanam rāmasya pūrayām āsuḥ purīṃ jānapadā janāḥ
english: These rural folk, arriving at the city from all the quarters to witness Rāma's consecration, filled Rāma's city to overflowing.

sanskrit: janaughais tair visarpadbhiḥ śuśruve tatra niḥsvanaḥ parvasūdīrṇavegasya sāgarasyeva niḥsvanaḥ
english: From those spreading surges of human multitudes a roar was heard there, like the roar of the ocean whose currents surge and swell during the days of the full and new moon.

sanskrit: tatas tad indrakṣayasaṃnibhaṃ puraṃ didṛkṣubhir jānapadair upāgataiḥ samantataḥ sasvanam ākulaṃ babhau samudrayādobhir ivārṇavodakam
english: Then that city, resembling the abode of Indra, became on all sides noisy and crowded with the rural people who had come to behold it, even as the waters of the ocean are crowded and teeming with the creatures of the sea.
